messages:
sarah_marketing: quick ask — finalizing launch blog + webinar. want to validate a small benchmark snapshot we can safely cite: compare coldstart vs warmed p95 and per-token ms for redwood-14b-fp16 and redwood-14b-q4. hosting: us-west-2. slices: short (20-40 tok) and long (200-400 tok). streaming off. samples: 1500 per variant, seed=913, warmup=50, sequential (concurrency=1). please produce p50/p90/p95, per-token ms (server-side), and attach CSV + one-slide PNG. if coldstart p95 > warmed p95 by >35%, add a slide note recommending 50-request warmup. can you run today?

miguel_runtime: ack. two quick clarifiers: (1) coldstart defined as first req after how long idle? (2) report per-token as avg across tokens or token-by-token timeline? also we should capture model load time + GPU warm metrics.

sarah_marketing: define coldstart = first request after 15 minutes idle. report both aggregated per-token ms and token emission timeline for long-contexts. include model load + GPU load times in metadata.

priya_eng: 1500 is fine for a marketing snapshot but call this a smoke run. if you plan to publish a concrete p95 delta, we should re-run the affected slice at 5k to tighten CI. we'll include a short README with CIs and exact metric definitions.

miguel_runtime: ok scheduling now. i'll run model pairs and slices sequentially. artifacts: CSV (per-request), token_events.csv, run_meta.txt, summary.png. i'll attach artifacts link here when done.

emma_ops: heads-up us-west-2 GPU quota is constrained this afternoon. i'll reserve one host for the window so the job doesn't queue. ping me if you'd rather run Dedicated later.

miguel_runtime: reproducible command (exact):
``
python infra/bench.py \
  --cohort cohorts/launch_long_short_seed913.json --seed 913 \
  --model redwood-14b-q4 --region us-west-2 \
  --requests 1500 --warmup 50 --concurrency 1 --streaming false \
  --slices short,long --out artifacts/launch/313579_run_q4
``
swap --model for fp16 runs and change out path accordingly. tagging run_id=313579_runset_A.

miguel_runtime: kicking off job 77123 at 15:10 PT. deploybot: bench-job-77123 started :robot_face:

deploybot: job 77123 status: running

miguel_runtime: interim: long-slice q4 streaming-off p95 coldstart looks ~42% higher than warmed p95 — attaching interim CSV in artifacts/interim_313579_q4_long.csv. we'll finish remaining slices and produce final PNG. if any p95 outliers are suspicious we'll re-run that slice at 5k.

priya_eng: noted. we'll compute CI and include a small footnote: "sample size=1500 per variant; seed=913; server-side token timings; see artifacts for full CSVs and README."

deploybot: job 77123 status: completed 6a7 artifacts uploaded: artifacts/launch/313579_runset_A.zip

miguel_runtime: done — summary PNG at artifacts/launch/313579_summary.png and full CSVs in the zip. added run_meta.txt with exact commands and instance IDs.

sarah_marketing: perfect, thank you. i'll draft the slide with the warmup note and link to artifacts. participants: sarah_marketing, miguel_runtime, priya_eng, emma_ops, jamie_product, deploybot
